summary: Defines two optional extensions to TFTP, the Trivial File Transfer Protocol. One lets the client and server agree on how long to wait before retransmitting, and the other lets the receiving side learn the total size of a file before the transfer begins. It was a standards-track document, later replaced by RFC 2349.

eli5.summary: Two computers passing a file back and forth can agree how long to wait for an answer, and the receiver can ask how big the package is before it starts unpacking.
